第020章 你自宫吧！
风无忧干咳一声，随即解释道：“你师父我这人比较懒，收太多的弟子管着也麻烦，便只收了两名弟子。”
“好吧。”岳雨觉得人少也不错，人多了难免会有一些狂傲的傻B，来对自己冷嘲热讽，人少也能免去一些傻B的骚扰。
“你师父我虽然只收了两名弟子，但这两名弟子可谓都是天才之中的佼佼者，一万名天才弟子都比不上他二人。”风无忧一脸欣慰，自豪地说道。
天才不在于多，而在于精。岳雨心里也是明白。
“师父！你终于回来了啊！想死我了！”一道惊喜的娇呼声从远处飘荡而来，声音清脆悦耳。
岳雨便顺着声音传来的方向看去，便看到了一个长着一张娃娃脸的女孩，看上去十三，四岁的样子。女孩一身粉红色的长裙，身材婀娜，乌黑柔顺的秀发随意披在身后。晶莹如玉般的肌肤，如同凝脂般细腻。柳叶眉，丹凤眼，眼睛大而灵动，鼻梁挺翘，美丽而又可爱的容颜上带着几分惊喜之色。玉足轻点，长袖飘飘，犹如轻歌曼舞一般。给人的感觉如含苞待放，充满着青春的气息。
“好美啊！好灵动的身法！”岳雨心中暗赞，在看到女孩的一瞬间，心里不由生出一种想要想去疼爱她的感觉。
“师父，怎么这么长时间才回来啊？你不在都没人陪我玩了。”女孩身影飘落而下，可爱的脸蛋布满了红霞。撅着小嘴，有些责怪地说道。
“呵呵，师父这么长时间才回来，是师傅的错。凌儿，看起来又长高了啊。”风无忧和蔼的一笑，看着女孩一脸的宠溺。
“咦？！哇！大哥哥，你好帅啊！比小白还要帅！”女孩看到一旁的普通人，短暂的惊讶后，灵动的大眼睛好奇的看着岳雨，惊叹道。
“呵呵，一般一般，九界第一！”岳雨神态谦虚地说道。被如此美丽可爱的女孩夸赞，心中暗自得瑟。同时心中也是微微有些疑惑，小白是谁？
岳雨神态谦虚，说的话却是一点也不谦虚，自恋程度让凤无忧一阵无语。
“师父，这位大哥哥是谁啊？”
风无忧还从未带人来过赤灵峰，这次带人来还是她第一次看到。更让她奇怪的是，还是个无法修炼的普通人，便看着风无忧，好奇地问道。
风无忧刚准备开口，岳雨便一脸文人气质，抢先说道：“美女，我就是风流倜傥，玉树临风。人见人爱,花见花开,车见爆胎,鸟见鸟呆，棺材见了也开盖……风靡万千少女的九界第一大帅哥！岳雨！”
风无忧一头栽倒在地，这小子也太自恋了吧？！
听着岳雨那一连串精辟的语句，女孩顿时充满仰慕的凝视着岳雨，灵动的大眼睛里满是星星，“大哥哥，你好有才啊！比小白还要有才！”
岳雨心中一阵得瑟，疑惑的问道：“小白是谁？”
“一条狗。”

岳雨一头栽倒在地，原来半天，女孩是拿狗来和自己做比较！
看着岳雨一脸郁闷的样子，风无忧忍不住笑出了声。
“呃，大哥哥，小白不是一条普通的狗，他是一条幻化成人形的狗。”女孩解释道。
岳雨闻言一讶，问道：“幻化人形？他的修为是元神境？！”只有元神境的灵兽才可以幻化成人形，小白是元神境的强者？！岳雨心里自然惊讶。
“以前是，现在不是了。”女孩神色顿时变得有些气愤，灵动的眼睛里散发着丝丝寒意。
风无忧也是眉头微皱，随即轻咳了一声，道：“凌儿，岳雨是我新收的徒弟。”
女孩眼睛一亮，有些惊讶地问道：“大哥哥，你隐匿了自己的气息？！”
“呃，我无法修炼，只是个普通人。”岳雨有些‘惭愧’地说道。
“普通人？师父，你？！”女孩像是想到了什么，看着风无忧，脸上洋溢着开心激动的笑容。
风无忧微微一笑，道：“岳雨，凌儿以后便是你的师姐了。”
“嘻嘻，我叫风凌儿，你以后得叫我师姐了啊。有什么人敢欺负你，师姐帮你教训他！”风凌儿挥了挥粉嫩的小拳头，颇为欣喜的说道。
“叫你凌儿可不可以？”岳雨轻声问道。
叫一个十三，四岁的女孩为师姐，感觉怪怪的，岳雨开不了这口。
“不行！就叫师姐！”风凌儿坚决地说道。
“行！乖，听话。”
“就叫师姐！”
口舌战！岳雨VS风凌儿！岳雨胜！
“师兄，你快点教我玩啊。”
“师兄，再给我讲个笑话，太好笑了。”
“师兄……”

几分钟后，风凌儿坚决地神色完全发生转变，一脸激动兴奋的模样，瞪着大大的眼睛，娇滴滴的叫着一声声师兄。
岳雨淡淡的一笑，道：“改天吧。”
心中却是一阵得瑟，“一个异界小女孩也敢和我拼口舌，小菜！”
“嗯！”风凌儿高兴地点了点头。
一旁的风无忧一阵感叹,“太能说了！太猥琐了！”
一个简朴的房间内，一名少年忍着剧痛，将插在屁股上的箭支狠狠地拔了下来，疼痛使得他的脸色显得有些狰狞。少年双拳紧握，怒火暗生，眼神之中透露着浓浓的怨恨。此人便是被岳雨给一箭爆了菊的少年，名杨傲。
杨傲看着自己下体处被刺穿的东东，少年心中的怒火瞬间升到了极致。两眼瞪得奇大，牙齿咬得咯咯直响。
“啊！臭小子！我一定会把你碎尸万段！”杨傲压制不住心中的怒火与愤恨，大声怒吼。周身凌厉的气息，带着无比强烈的杀意。
“哈哈，小家伙，你拿什么杀他？”一道沙哑阴沉的声音在杨傲的脑海中响起。
杨傲心头一震，眼神之中充满震惊与恐慌。因为他感觉到了一道强大的气息，魔气！魔修才会用有的气息！
“谁？！”杨傲压制下心头的震惊与恐慌，警惕的看着四周。
这时，一团黑影浮现。犹如烟雾一般，弥漫开来，缓缓形成了一道人影。
看着眼前的魔修，杨傲心中的恐惧瞬间攀升，身体都微微颤抖。魔修都是杀人不眨眼的魔头，为了活命，杨傲眼中狠色一闪，全身灵力猛然运转，一掌朝着黑影狠狠地劈了过去！
“哼！不自量力！”
黑影一声冷哼，紧接着一股浑厚的威压铺天盖地般的压下。杨傲根本无法挡住黑影的威压，瞬间便被也趴在了地上。威压就仿佛是一座泰山，而自己则如一只蝼蚁一般。
杨傲费力地抬起头，眼前的黑色人影，根本无法用肉眼看透。
黑影的气息骤然一变，散发着恐怖而强大的杀意。
感受着强烈的杀意，杨傲脸色顿时一变，惊恐的乞求道：“前辈，我狗眼不识泰山，你就放过我吧，只要你不杀我，让我做什么我都愿意！”
“嘿嘿，放心吧，我不会杀你的。”黑影邪邪一笑，气息顿时收敛。
杨傲心头也是一松，擦了擦额头的冷汗，便恭敬地谢道：“多谢前辈不杀之恩！”

“想要变强吗？想要成为天灵界的霸主吗？”黑影语气阴森地问道。
杨傲微微一怔，猜不透黑影所为何意，便应道：“想！”
“想就好，我会传你《天魔嗜血决》，成为破空境的强者轻而易举，就是踏入仙道都不是问题！”黑影语气带着强烈的自信。
“破空境？！仙道境？！”杨傲听后心中的恐惧瞬间消散，激动万分。
“多谢前辈！多谢前辈！前辈赶快传我神功吧！”杨傲眼中充满兴奋与期待。
“你先自宫吧！”

Chapter 020 You can commit suicide!
Feng Wuyou coughed dryly, and then explained: "Your master, I am a lazy person. It would be troublesome to accept too many disciples, so I only accepted two disciples."
"Okay." Yue Yu thinks that it is good to have fewer people. If there are more people, there will inevitably be some arrogant fools who will sarcastically mock him. But having fewer people can also avoid the harassment of some fools.
"Although your master and I have only accepted two disciples, these two disciples can be said to be the best among geniuses. Ten thousand genius disciples are not as good as these two." Feng Wuyou said proudly with a look of relief.
Genius does not lie in more, but in essence. Yue Yu also understood in his heart.
"Master! You are finally back! You miss me so much!" A pleasant voice of surprise floated from a distance, the sound was clear and sweet.
Yue Yu looked in the direction of the sound and saw a girl with a baby face who looked to be thirteen or fourteen years old. The girl is wearing a pink dress, with a graceful figure, and her black and silky hair is casually draped behind her. Skin as crystal clear as jade, as delicate as gelatin. She has willow eyebrows, red phoenix eyes, big and smart eyes, a straight nose, and a beautiful and lovely face with a hint of surprise. The jade feet are light and the long sleeves are fluttering, as if singing and dancing. It feels like a bud ready to bloom, full of youthful atmosphere.
"So beautiful! Such a nimble movement!" Yue Yu secretly praised in his heart. The moment he saw the girl, he couldn't help but feel a desire to love her.
"Master, why did it take you so long to come back? There's no one to play with me when you're not here." The girl's figure floated down, her lovely face covered with red clouds. He pouted his mouth and said somewhat reproachfully.
"Haha, it's Master's fault that it took so long to come back. Ling'er, it looks like you've grown taller again." Feng Wuyou smiled kindly, looking at the doting look on the girl's face.
"Eh?! Wow! Big brother, you are so handsome! Even more handsome than Xiao Bai!" The girl was briefly surprised when she saw the ordinary people on the side, then looked at Yue Yu curiously with her big and smart eyes, and exclaimed.
"Haha, just average, number one in the Nine Realms!" Yue Yu said humbly. Being praised by such a beautiful and lovely girl makes me feel secretly jealous. At the same time, I was slightly confused, who is Xiaobai?
Yue Yu's demeanor was modest, but what he said was anything but modest. His level of narcissism left Feng Wuyou speechless for a while.
"Master, who is this big brother?"
Feng Wuyou has never brought anyone to Chiling Peak before, and this is the first time she has seen it. What made her even more strange was that he was still an ordinary person who couldn't cultivate, so she looked at Feng Wuyou and asked curiously.
Just as Feng Wuyou was about to speak, Yue Yu said with a scholarly look on his face: "Beauty, I am a charming and charming man, like a jade tree facing the wind. Loved by everyone, flowers blooming, cars bursting with tires, birds stunned, even coffins opened... The most handsome guy in the nine realms who is popular with thousands of girls! Yue Yu!"
Feng Wuyou fell to the ground. Isn't this kid too narcissistic? !
Listening to Yue Yu's series of incisive sentences, the girl immediately stared at Yue Yu with admiration, her big and smart eyes full of stars, "Brother, you are so talented! Even more talented than Xiao Bai!"
Yue Yu felt anxious and asked doubtfully: "Who is Xiaobai?"
"A dog."
Yue Yu fell to the ground. It turned out that for a long time, the girl was comparing the dog with herself!
Seeing Yue Yu's depressed look, Feng Wuyou couldn't help but laugh.
"Well, big brother, Xiaobai is not an ordinary dog, he is a dog that transforms into a human form." The girl explained.
Yue Yu was surprised when he heard this and asked: "Transform into human form? His cultivation is in the Yuanshen realm?!" Only spiritual beasts in the Yuanshen realm can transform into human forms. Is Xiaobai a strong person in the Yuanshen realm? ! Yue Yu was naturally surprised.
"It used to be, but it's not now." The girl's expression suddenly became a little angry, and she was smart.There was a hint of coldness in his eyes.
Feng Wuyou also frowned slightly, then coughed slightly and said: "Ling'er, Yue Yu is my new disciple."
The girl's eyes lit up and she asked in surprise: "Brother, you hide your aura?!"
"Well, I can't practice, I'm just an ordinary person." Yue Yu said with some shame.
"Ordinary people? Master, you?!" The girl seemed to have thought of something, looking at Feng Wuyou, with a happy and excited smile on her face.
Feng Wuyou smiled slightly and said, "Yue Yu, Ling'er will be your senior sister from now on."
"Hehe, my name is Feng Ling'er. You have to call me Senior Sister from now on. If anyone dares to bully you, Senior Sister will help you teach him a lesson!" Feng Ling'er waved her pink little fist and said happily.
"Can I call you Ling'er?" Yue Yu asked softly.
It felt weird to call a thirteen or fourteen-year-old girl senior sister, and Yue Yu couldn't say it.
"No! Just call me Senior Sister!" Feng Ling'er said firmly.
"Okay! Be good and obey me."
"Just call me Senior Sister!"
War of words! Yue Yu VS Feng Ling'er! Yue Yusheng!
"Brother, hurry up and teach me how to play."
"Senior brother, tell me another joke, it's so funny."
"Senior brother..."
A few minutes later, Feng Ling'er's resolute expression completely changed, her face looked excited and excited, her eyes widened, and she called out "Senior Brother" sweetly.
Yue Yu smiled faintly and said, "Let's wait another day."
But there was a feeling of dismay in his heart, "A little girl from another world dares to argue with me, Xiaocai!"
"Yeah!" Feng Ling'er nodded happily.
Feng Wuyou on the side sighed, "You are so eloquent! You are so vulgar!"
In a simple room, a young man endured severe pain and pulled out the arrow stuck in his butt. The pain made his face look a little ferocious. The young man clenched his fists, anger was secretly rising, and his eyes revealed deep resentment. This person is the young man whose chrysanthemum was exploded by Yue Yu with an arrow, named Yang Ao.
Yang Ao looked at the thing that was pierced in his lower body, and the anger in the young man's heart instantly rose to the extreme. His eyes were widened and his teeth were clenching.
"Ah! Brat! I will definitely cut you into pieces!" Yang Ao couldn't suppress the anger and resentment in his heart and roared loudly. The sharp aura around him carried extremely strong killing intent.
"Haha, little guy, why are you killing him?" A hoarse and gloomy voice sounded in Yang Ao's mind.
Yang Ao was shocked, his eyes filled with shock and panic. Because he felt a powerful breath, devilish energy! Only demon cultivators can use certain auras!
"Who?!" Yang Ao suppressed the shock and panic in his heart and looked around vigilantly.
At this time, a black shadow appeared. Like smoke, it spread out and slowly formed a figure.
Looking at the demon cultivator in front of him, the fear in Yang Ao's heart instantly rose, and his body trembled slightly. Demonic cultivators are all demons who kill without blinking an eye. In order to survive, Yang Ao's eyes flashed with a ruthless look, his spiritual power suddenly circulated, and he struck hard at the black shadow with a palm!
"Hmph! You are not overestimating your own abilities!"
The black shadow snorted coldly, followed by an overwhelming pressure. Yang Ao was unable to block the black shadow's pressure at all, and was instantly thrown to the ground. The pressure is like a Mount Tai, and he is like an ant.
Yang Ao raised his head with difficulty. The black figure in front of him was impossible to see through with the naked eye.
The aura of the black shadow suddenly changed, exuding a terrifying and powerful killing intent.
Feeling the strong killing intent, Yang Ao's face suddenly changed, and he begged in horror: "Senior, I can't see Taishan, just let me go. As long as you don't kill me, I will do whatever you ask me to do!"
"Hehe, don't worry, I won't kill you." Black Shadow smiled evilly, and his breath suddenly converged.
Yang Ao felt relieved, wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, andHe thanked me respectfully: "Thank you, senior, for not killing me!"
"Do you want to become stronger? Do you want to become the overlord of the Heavenly Spirit Realm?" Black Shadow asked in a sinister tone.
Yang Ao was slightly startled, unable to guess what the black shadow meant, so he responded: "I think!"
"Just think about it, I will teach you the "Heavenly Demon Bloodthirsty Art". It will be easy to become a strong man in the sky-breaking realm. Even entering the immortal path will not be a problem!" Heiying said with strong confidence.
"Breaking Sky Realm?! Immortal Realm?!" After hearing this, Yang Ao's fear instantly dissipated and he was extremely excited.
"Thank you, senior! Thank you, senior! Senior, hurry up and teach me your magical skills!" Yang Ao's eyes were full of excitement and expectation.
"You should commit suicide first!"
